body:
The bounded JSON parser entry prototype is rejected and restored. Eight balanced
release pairs on macOS arm64 preserve all 640 selected current-version, ordered
Focus, excerpt and response-budget checks; full normalized outputs match. Ordinary
results change direction and rich-context median savings are only 0.12–0.69 ms.
This does not establish a useful complete-read benefit or a broad tail gain.

The retained metadata counter and independent Focus counter changes remain.
Documentation/package validation passes; there is no new application restart or
full-gate/browser claim for rejected code. Owner card changes remain separate.
Next measure context entry construction without copying full source bodies, while
preserving validation, current versions, projected metadata and UTF-8 excerpts.
Broader performance, physical-device/platform and release acceptance remain open.
See progress/2026-10-01-source-map-probe.md.

metadata.summary: Reject an unhelpful bounded JSON map lookup prototype
